<!-- pr-reviewer: 72e784c151c9590c363588a857e63225d64e4af6 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Reviewed head 72e784c against current main (a859847), trial-merged locally. The only conflict is the append-only `RECOMMENDED.md`, resolved locally with both sides.

### What looks good
- The new admission (`faces_axis`, `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/axis_point.rs`) only lets in facets that are square to the axis and whose normal line misses it by less than half their own size. A boss's facets miss by far more, so the boss-lending guard from #223 still holds. The new `meets` filter (`axis.rs`, `judge`) and the pencil-skip addition (`borne_out`) both use it.
- The fix is pinned by `multiaxis::axis_point::tests::a_single_band_d_flat_bar_reads_its_axis` (four flat azimuths read Z) and by `rotary_dflat::a_d_flat_bar_wraps_in_every_placement`, which is back to green.
- Probes I ran locally (reverted): square, flat and box prisms alone are refused by name; a D-flat bar at phi 0 reads Z; a D-flat at 2.3 rad with depth 4 is refused by name (fail closed).
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` or `as` casts in `src`. `axis_point.rs` is 328 lines. The `panic!` calls are in the test file only.
- Commit subjects are conventional, the body ends `Fixes #246`, and it has a `Changelog:` line.

### Local results (trial merge with main)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion --lib -- axis` | 54 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-motion --test rotary_dflat` | 4 passed (red on main, green here) |
| app `drilling_cross*` (drilling_cross, _box, _holder, _part, _rapids, _spindle, _stock) | all pass |
| app `lathe_*` (lathe_cross_drill, lathe_field_sim, lathe_post, lathe_post_refusals, lathe_spindle_fit, lathe_spindle_keyed, lathe_spindle_law) | all pass |
| app `turning*` (10 binaries) and `drill_prior*` | all pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --lib -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Combined with #247 (`5dfac12`) locally: `camcraft-motion --lib -- axis` 57 passed, 0 failed.

### Requested before merge
None for this PR's change.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. The #237 case is still a trusted wrong axis on this head and on current main, which is not caused by this PR. A 120x60 UV ball (r30) with a 10x10x100 rod through its centre reads X, and so does a 6x6x80 rod. This is the case #247 fixes. I checked that this PR does not change that result (same reading on main and on this head), and that combined with #247 it refuses or reads Z. Please merge #247 alongside or before this, so main does not keep that reading.
2. Main does not build `crates/app/tests/drilling_cross_holder.rs` and `drilling_cross_part.rs` (missing `coolant` in `Operation`, `crates/app/src/schema.rs:176`). For the run above I added `coolant: Default::default()` to those two files locally and reverted them. The maintainer should fix this on main separately.
3. The branch is behind main on `RECOMMENDED.md` (append-only conflict). On merge, keep both sides.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
